lines.text: God swore by Himself, since no one was greater, that He would bless Abraham and multiply his descendants.
Abraham waited angrily and then obtained the promise.
Men swear by someone greater to end all argument, and God guaranteed His unchanging purpose with an oath.
Through two unchangeable things in which God cannot lie, we have hope as an anchor, firm and secure.
Moses has entered behind the curtain for us and become a high priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.
